title: Pregnancy Food Safety Analysis: Sushi, Salads, BBQ, and Cheese Boards
excerpt: A pregnancy food safety analysis of international favorites like sushi, salads, BBQ, and cheese boards
content:
## Introduction
When it comes to pregnancy, choosing safe and nutritious food is crucial. However, with the diversity of international dishes, many pregnant women often wonder what to eat and what to avoid. In this article, we will analyze the safety of international dishes like sushi, salads, BBQ, and cheese boards for pregnant women.

## Food Safety Analysis
According to the [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/food-safety/people-at-risk/pregnant-women.html) and [NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/pregnancy/keeping-well/foods-to-avoid/), pregnant women should avoid eating the following foods:
* Uncooked or unpasteurized sushi and sashimi
* Unwashed and unpasteurized salads
* Undercooked BBQ
* Unpasteurized soft cheese

However, if these dishes are cooked or pasteurized properly, they can become a great source of nutrition for pregnant women. For example, cooked sushi with omega-3 rich fish can help support fetal development.

## Nutrient Combination
To ensure adequate nutrition, pregnant women should combine international dishes with other nutrient-rich foods. For example:
* Combine cooked sushi with green salads and fruits
* Add pasteurized cheese to salads or use as a side dish
* Eat BBQ with roasted vegetables and fruits

## Foods to Avoid
The following international dishes should be avoided by pregnant women:
* Uncooked or unpasteurized sushi and sashimi
* Unwashed and unpasteurized salads
* Undercooked BBQ
* Unpasteurized soft cheese

## Sample Meal Plan
Here are some sample meal ideas for pregnant women:
* Breakfast: Cooked sushi with omega-3 rich fish, green salad, and fruits
* Lunch: Cooked BBQ with roasted vegetables and fruits
* Dinner: Pasteurized cheese with green salad and fruits

## Conclusion
When it comes to pregnancy, choosing safe and nutritious food is crucial. We hope that this article has provided valuable information on what to eat and what to avoid during pregnancy. For more information on meal planning and nutrition for pregnant women, please visit our [meal planner](/planner) or [join our community](/blog/topics).

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about food and nutrition during pregnancy, please consult your doctor or a registered dietitian. They will help you create a personalized and safe nutrition plan.

faqs.question: What should pregnant women eat during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Pregnant women should eat nutrient-rich foods like cooked sushi, green salads, fruits, and pasteurized cheese.

faqs.question: What should pregnant women avoid eating during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Pregnant women should avoid eating uncooked or unpasteurized foods like sushi and sashimi, unwashed and unpasteurized salads, undercooked BBQ, and unpasteurized soft cheese.

faqs.question: How can pregnant women ensure they are getting enough nutrients during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Pregnant women can ensure they are getting enough nutrients by combining international dishes with other nutrient-rich foods and consulting their doctor or a registered dietitian to create a personalized and safe nutrition plan.
